title: Set up project environment and dependencies
description: Initialize the project with Godot 4.5.1 .NET, .NET 8 SDK, and ensure packages.lock.json is present.
acceptance: task-0001.json must include machine-readable fields for godot_version, dotnet_version, packages_lock_exists, and evidence_paths; missing any field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must provide explicit pass/fail conclusions for Windows-only and UTF-8 compliance with traceable evidence sources; vague statements (for example, "checked") fail acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must list all evidence paths for Task 1, and every path must resolve to an existing file under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/; any broken path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

On Windows, GODOT_BIN must be set to the absolute path of the Godot 4.5.1 .NET console executable, and .NET-console flavor must be proven by both executable identity evidence and version-command output captured from that exact path; task-0001.json must record godot_bin_env.env_var_name="GODOT_BIN", godot_bin_env.env_var_value (absolute path), godot_bin_env.env_var_scope (Process/User/Machine), and installation verification result. Missing any required field or non-absolute path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must execute `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version`; command must succeed and stdout must include "4.5.1". Running `godot --version` is optional evidence when PATH is configured; if provided, it must also report "4.5.1". Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-bin-version.txt; when `godot --version` is available, its full stdout must be persisted to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-version.txt. Missing required evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must record command, exit_code, parsed_version, and evidence_file for each Godot version command; missing any key fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

After installing .NET 8 SDK, running `dotnet --version` must start with "8.", and `dotnet --list-sdks` must contain at least one 8.x SDK entry; 7.x, 9.x, empty output, missing 8.x SDK entry, or command failure fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

If packages.lock.json is missing before restore, running `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` must generate it; if it already exists, it must remain present and correspond to the same NewRouge.sln restore scope. A lock file outside the NewRouge.sln restore scope does not satisfy acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Before toolchain checks are accepted, `.\NewRouge.sln` must exist in repository workspace and be the exact restore target used in evidence; missing solution file or mismatched restore target fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Must create logs/ directory structure for evidence, including at minimum logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/, and store readable evidence files covering Godot version checks, dotnet version, dotnet SDK list, packages.lock.json existence, Windows-only result, and UTF-8 result; any missing required directory or evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Acceptance artifacts must explicitly back-link ADR-0031 and ADR-0011 (for example via refs in task-0001.json and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

UTF-8 compliance must be validated at file level: task-0001.json, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md, and generated evidence files under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/ must decode as UTF-8 without errors; task-0001.json must include utf8_check.result="pass", utf8_check.checked_files (non-empty), and utf8_check.evidence_file. Any decode failure or missing required field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Windows-only is a hard gate: os_platform must be Windows, and task-0001.json must include windows_only_check.result="pass" with platform evidence. Non-Windows or missing evidence fails and must stop downstream gates. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1WindowsPlatformGateTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/dotnet-restore.txt; missing evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

task-0001.json must include dotnet_restore.command, dotnet_restore.exit_code, and dotnet_restore.evidence_file; dotnet_restore.command must target NewRouge.sln (semantic equivalent of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln`), and dotnet_restore.exit_code must equal 0. Missing any key, wrong restore target, or non-zero exit_code fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs
test_strategy: Check Godot version via 'godot --version', .NET version via 'dotnet --version', and verify packages.lock.json exists. Log environment evidence to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.

title: Create core project structure and namespaces
description: Establish directory boundaries: Game.Core, Game.Godot, Game.Core.Tests, Tests.Godot. Enforce NewRouge.* namespace.
acceptance: Repository root must contain Game.Core/, Game.Godot/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Game.Core/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/ must each contain a .csproj with TargetFramework=net8.0 and Nullable=enable; Game.Godot/ is a script/resource directory and must not contain any standalone .csproj. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Game.Core must not reference any Godot package or API. taskdoc/task-0002-change-set.json is the authoritative Task 2 C# scope and must include Game.Core/Conventions and Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2* entries (plus optional Tests.Godot Task2 C# entries); every listed file must declare namespaces under NewRouge.*; legacy Game.* may remain outside Task 2 scope. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

If legacy Game.* namespaces are present, they may coexist with NewRouge.*; Task 2 does not require full repository rename. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Task 2 completion must include sc-acceptance-check step `dotnet-build-warnaserror` with exit_code=0 as root build proof; if this gate is not executed or fails, Task 2 must remain non-done and progression must be blocked. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs
test_strategy: Validate root directories and .csproj settings for Game.Core, Game.Core.Tests, and Tests.Godot; treat Game.Godot as script/resource directory. Refs: ADR-0024.
Gate evidence: root build pass is enforced by sc-acceptance-check dotnet-build-warnaserror (exit code 0, no compiler errors), and Task2RootBuildGateTests validates build output classification.
Evidence note: structure snapshot may be stored as logs/ci/<date>/task-0002-structure.txt for review traceability.
Evidence note: capture sc-acceptance-check summary at logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/sc-acceptance-check-task-2/summary.json and keep dotnet-build-warnaserror step status for audit (non-Refs evidence).

title: Implement core contracts for card identity and forms
description: Define contracts in Game.Core/Contracts for card identity, forms (Base, U1A, U1B, Ultimate), and upgrade fields per ADR-0033.
acceptance: 在 Game.Core/Contracts 中定义 CardDefinition 与 CardInstance 契约：CardDefinition 至少包含 card_id，CardInstance 至少包含 instance_id、upgrade_tier、upgrade_route、permanent_card_instance_modifiers；并定义 Form 枚举（Base/U1A/U1B/Ultimate）与 Route 枚举（A/B）。上述契约需可被纯 .NET 测试项目直接引用并编译通过，且不得依赖任何 Godot 类型或命名空间。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

升级语义必须可被测试直接判定：当 upgrade_tier=2 时，upgrade_route 必须为 null；当 upgrade_tier 不为 2 且提供 upgrade_route 时，其值仅允许 A 或 B。对违反“tier=2 且 route 非 null”的输入，测试必须产生显式失败结果，且不能通过跳过断言、空测试、默认值回退或静默修正掩盖问题。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Game.Core.Tests/Contracts 下新增或更新 xUnit 测试，覆盖契约字段定义、Form/Route 枚举成员完整性、以及 tier=2→route=null 约束的正反两类用例；并验证测试工程保持纯 .NET 依赖且未引入 Godot 依赖。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

In Game.Core/Contracts, CardDefinition and CardInstance must be interface or class (record class allowed); reflection tests assert IsInterface or IsClass and reject other shapes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

Game.Core.Tests/Contracts must include reflection assertions that CardDefinition and CardInstance are IsInterface or IsClass (including record class); any other type shape fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

Negative tests must assert explicit failure when CardDefinition or CardInstance is struct, enum, or any non interface/class shape; missing negative gate fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests in Game.Core.Tests/Contracts to validate contract definitions and upgrade field constraints. Ensure no Godot dependencies. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0020.

title: Implement core contracts for offer locking and deterministic outcomes
description: Define contracts for offer locking structure, provenance, and RNG streams per ADR-0032 and Design Gate 05.
acceptance: Contracts layer provides concrete C# types `OfferLockSnapshot` and `OfferProvenance` that can be instantiated in tests; a schema-only or dictionary-only representation does not satisfy this requirement. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

`OfferLockSnapshot` includes `stable_ids`, `display_order`, `provenance`, `rng_stream`, and `locked_at_save_point` semantics (implemented as `IsLockedAtSavePoint`), and `Provenance` remains intact through value-object round-trip serialization/deserialization. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

`OfferProvenance` includes `source_type`, `source_id`, `act`, `floor`, `node_id`, `difficulty`, `rng_stream`, and `stream_pos` with contract-visible field/type definitions that tests can verify. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
In valid constructed samples, `OfferLockSnapshot.rng_stream` equals `OfferProvenance.rng_stream`; any mismatch fails contract validation. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
Offer-lock snapshots preserve `provenance.stream_pos` and explicitly carry save-point lock context as a boolean semantic. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

RNG stream categories are a closed set of `run`, `combat`, `event`, `loot`, `shop`, and `offer`; `OfferLockSnapshot.RngStream` and `OfferProvenance.RngStream` accept only this set, and unknown values fail validation tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RngStreamTypeTests.cs, Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
`stable_ids` are content-stable IDs, and changing only `display_order` does not change the `stable_ids` set. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

`locked_at_save_point` is represented by explicit boolean semantics (`IsLockedAtSavePoint`) and is reproducible for the same lock context; any optional `LockedAt` timestamp is informational only. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

Serialization/deserialization round-trip preserves full `OfferLockSnapshot` data; identical inputs (including `rng_stream` and `stream_pos`) produce identical outputs, and when `rng_stream` or `stream_pos` changes, `stable_ids` remain content-stable while provenance reflects the changed context. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

For identical lock inputs (context, candidates, provenance, save-point flag), deterministic retrieval returns equivalent snapshots for `StableIds`, `DisplayOrder`, `Provenance.RngStream`, `Provenance.StreamPosition`, and `IsLockedAtSavePoint`. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests to validate offer locking structure and provenance fields. Test serialization/deserialization for deterministic behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement core contracts for status and modifier system
description: Define contracts for status types (Buff, Debuff, RuleModifier), fields, and deterministic ordering per Design Gate 04.
acceptance: 可通过契约与测试断言验证：StatusType 必须包含 Buff、Debuff、RuleModifier，且必须定义 ExpiresTiming；Status 必须包含 status_id、stacks、duration_turns、source_id、expires_timing、strength 字段；对同一输入集合按 stable_id 排序时，多次执行得到完全一致的顺序；执行驱散后 RuleModifier 与 status.strength 相关效果仍保留。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
对同一初始状态执行同一操作序列时，Status 的叠加、duration_turns 累计与衰减结果必须一致且可断言；当某次操作前置条件不满足时，执行后状态必须与执行前完全一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖叠加规则、持续时长处理、驱散边界（含 RuleModifier 与 strength 不可驱散）以及 stable_id 排序确定性；任一规则被破坏时，至少一个对应测试用例失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
Status 契约必须提供叠加、持续时长累计、衰减三个可调用方法（命名可等价）；每个方法都必须能通过调用后的状态变化（或按规则不变化）直接断言，任一方法缺失、不可访问或不可断言即失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 must be present in task=5 adr_refs of both tasks_back.json and tasks_gameplay.json; any missing or mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs

ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 listed in ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md section "Task5 ADR Mapping" must exactly match task=5 adr_refs in both task views; any mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
驱散边界必须可观测：当同一集合同时包含可驱散状态与 RuleModifier 或 status.strength 相关效果时，驱散后仅可驱散状态被移除，RuleModifier 与 status.strength 相关效果保持不变；若任一不可驱散效果被移除则判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for status operations: stacking, duration handling, and dispel boundaries. Validate deterministic ordering via stable_id sorting. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.

title: Implement core contracts for combat loop and resolution pipeline
description: Define contracts for combat phases, damage calculation, and deterministic sequencing per Design Gates 01 and 03.
acceptance: Deliverables provide executable contracts for four scopes: CombatLoop phases, PlayCard resolution pipeline, damage calculation rules, and the OverplayTax difficulty threshold. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

xUnit contains behavioral assertions for phase transitions, pipeline order and short-circuit behavior, damage rules, OverplayTax threshold behavior, and deterministic execution. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Referenced test files contain executable assertions that prove Task6 contract obligations; stale, missing, or non-executable references fail semantic acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
CombatLoop contract exposes exactly four phases: StartOfTurn, Draw, Main, EndOfTurn; any missing or extra phase fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline contract enforces the exact canonical sequence Validate->ComputeCost->PayCost->BeforePlayTriggers->ResolveEffect->AfterPlayTriggers->MoveCard->DeathCheck, with no missing, extra, or reordered steps. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Damage contract applies Strength, Weak, and Vulnerable multipliers to mutable damage, and fixed damage remains exempt from mutable multipliers. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
OverplayTax is applied only when difficulty >= 10 and is not applied when difficulty < 10, with explicit boundary assertions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
Deterministic ordering uses combatant_id and stable_id to produce stable sequence output, and repeated runs with the same input stay identical. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 test suite includes both positive and negative paths for transitions, pipeline behavior, damage rules, OverplayTax behavior, and deterministic outcomes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
Phase transition guards reject invalid transitions and preserve unchanged combat state when rejection occurs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 contract behavior must stay consistent with ADR-0021 (state machine boundaries) and ADR-0032 (determinism), and tests must assert that alignment. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0006CombatContractsTraceabilityTests.cs
When Validate fails, pipeline execution stops at Validate and does not execute ComputeCost or later steps, with critical state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
xUnit includes an explicit Validate-failure case asserting that step trace stops at Validate and state remains unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
Tests assert both valid and invalid phase transition behavior, including guard rejection and unchanged state on invalid transitions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/CombatLoopPhaseTransitionTests.cs
Tests cover the OverplayTax boundary at difficulty 9 and 10 with explicit assertions for not-applied versus applied taxed-cost behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
All deterministic cases produce identical outputs for identical inputs and identical initial state, independent of run count. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Damage coverage executes a representative input matrix that proves multiplier and fixed-damage behavior across scenarios. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

[OBL:T6.O10] Multiplier and fixed-damage scenarios include normal cases, boundary cases, and negative/invalid inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Table-driven damage tests verify multiplier math, fixed-damage invariants, and deterministic numeric outputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop is implemented as an instantiable C# contract type in Game.Core and is directly usable by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] Contract completion requires executable behavior verified by tests, not descriptive-only declarations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop implementation is located under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat and referenced by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
PlayCard resolution applies OverplayTax during ComputeCost and consumes the taxed cost in PayCost when difficulty >= 10. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
When ComputeCost or PayCost fails, pipeline stops immediately at the failing step and keeps critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

For the same PlayCardPipelineInput and the same initial state, repeated runs produce identical ExecutedSteps, StateAfter, and ExecutionFingerprint. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

When any post-cost step (BeforePlayTriggers, ResolveEffect, AfterPlayTriggers, MoveCard, DeathCheck) fails, execution stops at the failing step and keeps critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline and damage calculation are defined as explicit executable contract types under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat (or subfolders), and tests reference those contract types directly rather than only service-side implicit behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

Deterministic sequencing contract defines comparator precedence (combatant_id first, stable_id second) and deterministic tie handling for equal keys, and tests assert this rule explicitly. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for combat phase transitions, damage calculation, and OverplayTax application. Ensure deterministic ordering via combatant_id and stable_id. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.

title: Set up event bus and contracts location
description: Implement event bus system and place contracts in Game.Core/Contracts per ADR-0004 and ADR-0020.
acceptance: 在 `Game.Core/Contracts` 下存在事件总线接口，并暴露可调用的发布与订阅方法；该目录是契约唯一来源，Godot 层仅通过引用使用，不能新增或复制同类契约定义。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例，能够实际验证“发布后可被订阅方接收”的行为（失败时会红灯）；并且在 Windows 上执行 `dotnet test` 通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务新增或更新的 xUnit 用例路径。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
在 `Game.Core/Contracts` 中定义 `CardPlayed` 与 `CombatStarted` 事件 DTO，且每个 DTO 含有可区分事件类型的常量或字段。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/GameEventContractsTests.cs
在组合根完成 `EventBus` 依赖注入注册；Godot 层通过接口解析并可实际调用该 `EventBus`。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/test_event_bus_adapter.gd
Godot 层在发布/订阅时使用 `Game.Core.Contracts` 中的 DTO 类型；仓库中不存在 Godot 层新增的同名契约定义文件。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/test_event_bus_adapter.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
通过自动化测试或可复现检索证据可确认：契约文件位于 `Game.Core/Contracts`，且 Godot 层无重复 DTO 定义。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Utilities/ContractsLocationAndDuplicationTests.cs

EventBus 验收需验证以下领域事件均可发布且可订阅：`core.combat.started`、`core.combat.card.played`、`core.reward.offer.locked`、`core.autosave.written`、`core.run.state.transitioned`；任一事件未被验证即验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for event publishing and subscription. Verify contracts are in correct location and not duplicated in Godot scripts. Refs: ADR-0004, ADR-0020.

title: Implement core logic for card identity and forms
description: Create core services for card definition, instance management, and form transitions per ADR-0033.
acceptance: CardService 必须对外提供按 card_id 获取定义、创建实例、执行 U1 升级与推进到 Ultimate 的能力；合法输入产生可断言的形态/层级结果，非法输入返回确定性失败且实例状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
按 card_id 查询定义时，命中返回唯一对应 CardDefinition；未命中必须产生可重复验证的确定性失败（同类输入得到同类失败输出）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
创建 CardInstance 时必须初始化 instance_id、base form 和修饰符容器，并保证实例身份与 CardDefinition 身份分离（实例变更不影响定义）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
实例在升级与 Ultimate 形态迁移后，permanent_card_instance_modifiers 必须按继承语义完整保留并可测试比对；若迁移被拒绝，修饰符与形态保持原值。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/CardInstanceTests.cs
upgrade_tier 与 upgrade_route 必须联合校验，U1 仅接受受支持的 tier/route 组合；非法组合触发硬失败且形态、层级、修饰符均不变化。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit 测试覆盖卡牌身份、card_id 查找命中/未命中、U1 路线升级、Ultimate 进阶与修饰符继承，并在测试描述中显式引用 ADR-0033。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/CardIdentityTests.cs
与本任务对应的 xUnit 用例应能直接定位并复现上述断言，覆盖 card identity、upgrade path 与 modifier inheritance。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs

When a card enters Ultimate form, Ultimate must become the active form for that instance and subsequent behavior must be resolved from the Ultimate form state. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
Ultimate transition must preserve existing permanent_card_instance_modifiers on the same card instance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit must verify card_id lookup hit and miss behavior with deterministic failure outputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs

CardDefinition and CardInstance contract fields required by instance creation must be non-empty/valid and assertion-readable in tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/ContractInstantiationCoverageTests.cs
xUnit must verify deterministic mapping from each allowed form transition to its observable effect description key/output. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit must verify route constraints and tier-route invariants for all legal and illegal inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O10] 创建 CardInstance 后，实例字段必须与合同字段一一对应；缺失或额外字段均判失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/ContractInstantiationCoverageTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O10] 对合同字段的默认值与类型进行可重复断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs
